name: Fern Gully Loop
about: A shady loop under tree ferns, with a creek crossing on stepping stones.

name: Eagle Ridge
about: A steady climb to a bare ridge. Eagles ride the wind above the last switchback.

name: Lantern Lake
about: Flat shoreline paths around a still lake. Bring a lantern for the sunset walk back.

name: Old Mill Path
about: A short stroll along the mill race to the old waterwheel.

name: Granite Steps
about: Hundreds of granite steps cut into the hillside, and a view worth every one.

name: Cedar Hollow
about: A cool valley of old cedars, with a mossy bridge halfway.
